app.name: Radici San Giovanni Lipioni

app.demoNotice: Demo guide: markers from public sources, editorial text to verify locally.

home.title: Radici San Giovanni Lipioni
home.intro: A digital guide to explore the village with an interactive map, real OpenStreetMap points, slow itineraries, demo stories and a chatbot based only on controlled content.
home.whyText: The project starts from a family and cultural bond with the village, arranging places, memories and expandable information without inventing local history.
home.placesText: Markers aligned with public OpenStreetMap points, with readable source notes.
home.itinerariesText: Short routes for slow tourism and respectful visits.
home.storiesText: Demo memories to replace with authorised real testimonies.
home.rootsText: The app separates public geographic data, editorial text and content still awaiting local validation, preparing a structure for real photos, local sources, backend and an evolved chatbot.
home.finalCtaText: Explore the mapped points and open the chatbot whenever you want to ask about available content.

explore.title: Explore the San Giovanni Lipioni map
explore.intro: Filter places, search by keyword and select a marker. The entry opens in the side space without covering the map and remains accessible from the mobile list.
explore.noResults: No places found with these filters.
explore.selectPromptText: Click a marker or card to open an entry with description, sources and quick actions.

itineraries.title: Itineraries to discover San Giovanni Lipioni
itineraries.intro: Three routes built on mapped places. Durations, stops and accessibility must be checked on site before final publication.

stories.title: Stories, memory and roots
stories.intro: A demo collection about return visits, everyday places and family ties. The texts are not real testimonies.

privacy.title: Privacy and Cookies
privacy.intro: This page explains simply how the demo works. This text is a demonstration model and must be validated by a legal consultant before final publication.
sections: Data controller: TODO. Privacy email: TODO. Address or registered office: TODO.
The demo does not include accounts, public forms, payments or user uploads.
localStorage is used for selected language, cookie preferences and non-sensitive UI state.
AnalyticsService is mock: no real analytics script is loaded before explicit consent.
Necessary cookies are always active; analytics, marketing and preferences are disabled by default and editable by the user.
Main geographic markers come from public OpenStreetMap sources; stories, editorial text and accessibility must be verified before real publication.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The requested route does not exist or is not planned in this demo yet.

chatbot.title: Radici assistant
chatbot.intro: Uses controlled content and suggests next steps.
chatbot.placeholder: Write a question about the village...
chatbot.welcome: Hello, I am the Radici assistant. I can help you choose an itinerary, read a place's sources or understand which content is still demonstrative. If I do not have verifiable data, I will say so and suggest what to check.
chatbot.fallback: I do not have enough controlled data to answer well. Try asking: what should I see in the centre, tell me about the church, where is Fontana Vecchia, or which itinerary do you recommend.
chatbot.openRelatedPlace: Open linked place on the map
quickPrompts: What should I see in the centre?

cookie.title: Cookie preferences
cookie.intro: The demo only uses technical functions. Optional categories remain disabled until you choose otherwise.
cookie.necessaryText: Always active for security, language and basic preferences.
cookie.analyticsText: Mock in the first version: no real service is loaded before consent.
cookie.marketingText: Not used in the demo, disabled by default.
cookie.preferencesText: Stores non-sensitive choices such as language and UI settings.

footer.description: Angular demo dedicated to San Giovanni Lipioni, designed for map, local memory, JSON data and future backend evolution.
